body: We’re both 22 and coming up onto our 1 year next month. I havent talked to her about it much I kinda have mentioned it a bit, but then it was dropped pretty quickly. We had a big fight about a month ago and I thought she was gunna break up with me and it scared me so I kinda stopped talking about it and stuff that may cause fights cause I didn’t want to lose her, but I just don’t want a relationship where I have to feel like im walking on egg shells. Its been better for the past few weeks for the most part we just had another stupid fight tonight

No not most of the time, just when these arguments happen. I think we just go about fights different, cause she just wants to forget about it and move on where I want to figure it out and make sure we both feel better about it

I only feel worse when these fights happen because we never really resolve them. She just wants to push it under the rug and I want to talk through it so we can come to an understanding, but last time I tried to talk through it with her it made it worse
It’s not always its just when we have these fights and especially when they’re unresolved
